title: 3D structure reconstruction of nanoengineered polymeric capsules using Coherent X-Ray diffraction imaging
author: Erokhina, Pastorino, et al.
materials: PSS was added to CaCO3 microparticles.

steps.title: Prepare CaCO3 microparticles
steps.instruction: Add 1 ml of 0.33 M sodium carbonate (Na2CO3) to 1 ml of 0.33 M calcium chloride (CaCl2) and mix to form CaCO3 microparticles.

steps.title: Wash microparticles
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the CaCO3 suspension and wash the pellet three times with ultrapure water.

steps.title: Prepare polyelectrolyte solutions
steps.instruction: Dissolve poly(sodium 4‑styrenesulfonate) (PSS) and poly(allylamine hydrochloride) (PAH) each at 2 mg ml⁻¹ in 0.15 M NaCl solution.

steps.title: Layer‑by‑layer coating of capsules
steps.instruction: Alternately adsorb PSS and PAH onto the CaCO3 particles to obtain the desired number of bilayers (3 or 6). For each bilayer: add PSS solution, centrifuge, discard supernatant, add PAH solution, centrifuge, discard supernatant; repeat until the required bilayer count is reached.

substeps.instruction: Repeat the above sequence until 3 or 6 bilayers are formed.

steps.title: Dissolve CaCO3 core with EDTA
steps.instruction: Suspend the coated particles in 1 ml of 0.2 M EDTA (pH 6) for 5 min to dissolve the CaCO3 template, then centrifuge and wash the resulting hollow capsules three times with ultrapure water.

steps.title: Add CdCl2 for contrast
steps.instruction: Add 1 ml of 0.125 M CdCl₂ to each capsule sample and store overnight at 4 °C to enhance X‑ray contrast.

steps.title: Wash and store capsules
steps.instruction: After the overnight incubation, centrifuge the capsules, wash them three times with ultrapure water, and keep them at 4 °C until further use.

steps.title: Adjust pH for pore control
steps.instruction: Set the capsule suspension to pH 4.0 to open pores or to pH 9.0 to close pores, depending on the intended experiment.

steps.title: Load gold nanoparticles
steps.instruction: Incubate the hollow capsules in a dispersion of gold nanoparticles (1 mg ml⁻¹) for 24 h with continuous shaking to load the particles.

steps.title: Assemble sample chamber
steps.instruction: Place two silicon nitride windows (frame 10 mm × 10 mm, membrane 3 mm × 2 mm, thickness 100 nm) into a 3D‑printed frame, add a 10 µl drop of a 1:10 diluted capsule solution, and seal the perimeter with vacuum grease to prevent evaporation.

substeps.instruction: Insert the silicon nitride windows into the 3D‑printed frame.
Add 10 µl of capsule suspension diluted 1:10.
Cover the entire perimeter with vacuum grease.

steps.title: Configure CXDI imaging parameters
steps.instruction: Set up the coherent X‑ray diffraction imaging experiment at the ID10 beamline (ESRF) using 8.1 keV X‑rays and a sample‑detector distance of 5280 mm.

steps.title: Acquire diffraction data
steps.instruction: Rotate the sample from –70° to +70° in 0.05° increments, recording a scattering pattern for 1 s at each angle; after every 50 frames, shift the frame vertically to keep the capsule in the beam.

substeps.instruction: Rotate sample to the next angle (0.05° step).
Collect a scattering pattern with 1 s exposure.
After 50 patterns, adjust vertical position of the frame.
Repeat until the full –70° to +70° range is covered.

steps.title: Process diffraction images
steps.instruction: Reconstruct the capsule structure from the acquired diffraction patterns using the established ID10 data‑processing protocol.
